ST-02.title: Fix nightly backtest total_pnl_gbp non-reproducibility
ST-02.spec_reference_not_applicable_reason: Data-integrity bug fix (BLG-BE-60) — no prior canonical spec describes the nightly import drift-check; verified via its own stated AC and tests/test_production_strategy.py::TestBacktestDeterminism / TestDriftAlert (regression tests).
ST-02.notes: Fix vehicle for RISK-01 selected at execution kickoff: option (c) — wired the existing drift-check output into an actual alert (import_backtest.check_drift_alert, threshold £50, distinct exit code 2, BACKTEST_DRIFT_ALERT: greppable log line). Options (a) persistent price caching and (b) append-only ledger deferred as larger follow-on work (more infra required — tracked as follow-on, not filed as a new backlog item since RISK-01 already documents them as open alternatives). AC-02 controlled re-run comparison satisfied via tests/test_production_strategy.py::TestBacktestDeterminism (proves no incidental nondeterminism in backtest() itself, given fixed inputs) — the external yfinance historical-price-revision nondeterminism is inherently outside a local test's reach and is exactly what the drift alert guards against in production instead. Files touched: import_backtest.py (check_drift_alert + wiring), production_strategy.py (main()-wrap refactor + dead matplotlib import removal — required to make compute_signals/backtest importable for AC-02 testing). .github/workflows/backtest.yml's matching pip-install cleanup was reverted in a follow-up commit — the push token lacks `workflow` OAuth scope to modify workflow files; harmless as-is (installs an unused package), not worth blocking the sprint on. Noted for PMO Lead awareness, not filed as a backlog item (trivial, no functional impact).
